package main

import (
    "context"
    "sync"
    "testing"
)

func TestCompiledProgramFactoriesDoNotRewriteRunningMetadata(t *testing.T) {
    start := make(chan struct{})
    var workers sync.WaitGroup
    for worker := 0; worker < 4; worker++ {
        workers.Add(1)
        go func() {
            defer workers.Done()
            <-start
            for i := 0; i < 50; i++ {
                program, err := generatedProgram(Host{})
                if err != nil { t.Error(err); return }
                if _, err := program.Run(context.Background(), nil, Options{}); err != nil {
                    t.Error(err); return
                }
            }
        }()
    }
    close(start)
    workers.Wait()
}

func TestCompiledHostCapabilitiesFrozen(t *testing.T) {
	host := Host{Capabilities: map[string]bool{"read": true}}
	program, err := generatedProgram(host)
	if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	host.Capabilities["read"] = false
	if !program.host.Capabilities["read"] { t.Fatal("compiled registry aliases the caller's capabilities") }
}

func TestClaimConflictRetainsVariantsAndHistoricalSnapshot(t *testing.T) {
	store := newClaimStore("run")
	position := Position{{1, "0"}}
	if err := store.join(position, number(1)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	before, err := store.read()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err = store.join(position, number(2)); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("accepted changing identity")
	}
	if _, err = store.read(); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("read conflicted store")
	}
	if len(store.variants[identityKey(joinWire("run", position))]) != 2 || before.l[0].o["value"].n != 1 {
		t.Fatal("conflict lost facts or changed a snapshot")
	}
}
